preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the multipleBotlistAddress() function with an array containing addresses of regular users (excluding the owner). Set the excluded parameter to true to blacklist those addresses. This will prevent them from making transfers while the owner remains unaffected. The vulnerability allows the owner to selectively stop transactions for any user.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner can abuse the multipleBotlistAddress() function to blacklist any address. This function is protected by onlyOwner modifier, giving the owner unchecked power to block transactions for any user. When an address is blacklisted, the _transfer() function will revert for any transaction involving that address as either sender or recipient, effectively freezing their funds.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call multipleBotlistAddress() to blacklist a victim address (attacker-controlled). This demonstrates the owner's ability to arbitrarily block users from transacting.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Create an array containing the attacker address. 4. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with the array and excluded=true. 5. Verify that _isBlacklisted[attacker] returns true.
